description: The griffin replaces the tinted fire dragon as the mount of the three griffin games
deviation_notes: The browser QC ran in the monorepo package (qc/run.mjs), because the Forge screenshot tool has no bot for these games. One added fix: the fly clip tucks the hind legs, so the chase camera of Griffin Riders Escape sees the rider. The dependency on asset_p2_monsters_20260928 was removed at close: that track stays open for its other batches, and the griffin it delivered (d0c3d6b) is done.
